steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Leave the battle here to me.
Hecate's figure looks normal, but you see many strange light specks manifesting in the air, and the entire space has become distorted.
An arrow flies out with a strange noise, exploding into unusual fireworks, followed by a robot-like girly voice.
Two more familiar figures stand in front of you.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? Chief, why are you inside this phone? What happened?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Uwaah... Chief, please come back! My voice has got so weird, and the VFX are so weird! My awesome arrow, my heroic image, all gone!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Master, sorry, my body feels strange. It's becoming soft and fragile. This might affect the battle in a bit.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: To ensure your safety, please... quickly... resolve the current issue...
Seeing your companions so close, you feel reassured and even a bit touched.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: How did you guys get here? You really shouldn't have come.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Yeah, we shouldn't have come. The original plan was to block the contamination leaking from the rift, but they wanted to cross over to find you, even at the cost of their own life. As it so happened, the shackles came through the rift and forced resonance at that very same moment.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: By the time we came back to our senses, we were already here.
You look at the cybersecurity expert, who smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I couldn't participate in the actual combat, so I borrowed Code Duck's device to study the rules of both worlds. I found something interesting.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: 000 seems to have used some special Mania she found on you to bypass the dimensional barriers. Given the fact that the shackles between you and the Sinners are a deeper connection, I went ahead and tested out a little theory of mine. As it happened, you just released your shackles at the very same moment...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hence a miraculous coincidence, I guess.
That sounds logical, but...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Before we got transported here, Rise grabbed us and tried to pull us out of the rift. As a result, she got dragged along, too.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Huh? I thought shackles were necessary. So, does that mean I can...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Stop joking around. Such threats to personal safety weren't covered in the contract.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Deal with the enemy before us immediately. I need to apply for work injury compensation when we get back.
Strangely, 000 makes no move during your talk. She just stands there, smiling at you from a distance.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: How do we resolve this? Can we awaken the god? Hey... O Mighty Deity... Rise and shine...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's useless. I don't think our voices can reach its ears. After all, someone is controlling the power.
Everyone looks at the unruly assassin, who is also scrutinizing you.
What a surprise... They all belong entirely to the other side, yet they were able to cross the barrier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What? You couldn’t foresee this, even with the power of the gods? Feeling scared now?
She giggles.
Not at all. Actually, I've always yearned for such lively scenes and wanted to join in. Come on!
Amidst the flickering light specks, the white Assassin Zone reappears. Various monsters instantly take shape and charge towards you.
